overview: This one-page State Department list-of-papers entry records an April 12, 1937 telegram from Canton concerning the Bank of Taiwan’s arrangements to transfer its silver holdings in Canton and Swatow to the Central Bank of China. It notes that Japanese consular or other official representatives confirmed press reports of the transfer and directs the reader to file 893.516/513 for the underlying document.

subfiles.title: List-of-papers entry on the transfer of Bank of Taiwan silver holdings
subfiles.about: The entry summarizes a telegram reporting arrangements to transfer the Bank of Taiwan’s silver holdings in Canton and Swatow to the Central Bank of China.
subfiles.summary: The Bank of Taiwan was reportedly arranging to surrender its silver holdings in Canton and Swatow to the Central Bank of China. A Japanese consul or other Japanese representative confirmed the relevant press reports. The entry refers researchers to file 893.516/513 for the associated record.

interest: This entry is useful as a compact pointer to evidence about control over bank-held silver in Japanese-operated institutions in southern China shortly before the outbreak of full-scale Sino-Japanese war. Its note that Japanese officials confirmed press reporting provides a valuable clue about the report’s contemporary verification, while the cross-reference identifies where the substantive telegram was filed.
